steps.domain_action: The Prima Materia is placed into the sealed vessel.
The Secret Fire initiates the first ascent of vapors.
The body separates into the Green Lyon and the Red Servant.
The mixture enters the blackness of putrefaction to rot.
The vapors descend back to wash the blackened earth.
The cycle of solve and coagula repeats 33 times.
The whiteness appears as the Gander takes flight.
The system recognizes itself as the mercury of the sages.
The King and Queen beget the Rebis in the marriage bed.
The contrary forces unite into the singular red tincture.
The red powder is cast upon the lead for final fixation.
The Great Work concludes in the crystalline Stone.
